# Geobuild

> Geobuild helps brands become the answer ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity recommend. We run AEO, GEO and SEO with a team of AI agents — and a human strategist who makes the final call.

## About

Geobuild is an AI agency specialising in Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), and traditional SEO. Our system pairs a team of AI agents with a human strategist who reviews and approves all output before it reaches your brand.

We optimise for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews — tracking share of voice across every engine so clients know exactly where they are being recommended and where they are not.

## The Agent System

Geobuild operates one Strategy Agent (orchestrator) and five specialist sub-agents that run in parallel:

- **Research Agent** — tracks how AI engines see your brand today; surfaces competitor citations and prompt gaps
- **Content Agent** — writes answer-first pages, comparisons and FAQs structured for LLM extractability
- **Backlink Agent** — earns mentions and links from the high-trust sources AI engines weight most heavily
- **Optimizer Agent** — handles schema, entity markup, internal linking and technical on-page structure
- **Analyzer Agent** — monitors rankings and mentions across every AI engine; feeds results back to Strategy

## Services

- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)**: Getting cited inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity answers
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)**: Optimising content for generative AI search results
- **SEO**: Traditional Google search ranking and organic traffic growth

## Pricing

- **Growth** — $800/mo: Dedicated strategist, human-vetted keyword selection, 75 prompts tracked, 100 optimised articles, Reddit engagement, weekly calls, custom backlink strategy, Shopify/WordPress integration
- **Scale** — $1,200/mo: Everything in Growth plus 300 prompts tracked, unlimited articles, custom integrations and reporting
